The '''Taloron Prey Chaser''' was a class of starship used by the [[Taloron Hunters]]. One such ship was the ''[[Scent of Fear]]'', under the command of [[Crutag]], who chased Rebels to the planet [[Trinta]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
